اقترضا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضَا (iqtaraḍā) /iq.ta.ra.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضَا (uqturiḍā) /uq.tu.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اِقْتَرِضَا (iqtariḍā) /iq.ta.ri.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
